verdict.rationale: Relay documents rule-based background automations: auto-transferring deposits by dollar amount or percentage, sweeping idle cash into savings, automatic accounting sync, recurring invoices with automated follow-up, and automated approval rules. A community user confirms the automatic money partitioning works but notes that external payments still have to be run by hand. The automations are fixed, money-movement-focused rules rather than open-ended autonomous workflows. Missing for 10: autonomous execution of external payments, a general-purpose or AI-driven automation builder, and hands-on evidence that sync and invoice follow-up run reliably.
